description: Data Scientist, real estate ontology MRI Software is hiring Data Scientists to turn a real estate ontology into products: the models, agents and analytics that only become possible when every property, lease, tenant, asset and transaction is described in one shared, machine-readable language. About the role MRI is building a Common Data Model that unifies data across its product portfolio. On top of it we are creating a real estate ontology: the entities, relationships, rules and semantics of the industry. You will be among the first data scientists to work on that foundation. Your job is to discover what can be built on it, prove it with working models and prototypes, and hand the winners to product teams. This is a research-to-product role. Expect to spend as much time finding the right problem as solving it. What you will do Help turn the Common Data Model into a real estate ontology: entities, relationships, constraints and business rules across leasing, property operations, assets, investments, and facilities. Explore the ontology with data to find high-value solutions: forecasting, anomaly detection, entity resolution, Decision modeling / recommendation, valuation signals, and portfolio optimization. Build and validate models on real product data from across the MRI portfolio, with clear baselines and honest evaluation. Prototype ontology-grounded AI: knowledge-graph retrieval, LLM agents that reason over typed entities, and natural-language analytics with a semantic layer. Define metrics and a semantic layer so that a number means the same thing in every product. Partner with product, engineering and domain experts to move proven prototypes into the MRI platform. Raise the bar on data quality: find mapping gaps, bad joins and silent failures, and feed them back into the model. What you bring Required Bachelor's or master's or PhD (from Premier Institute) in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics or a related quantitative field 3-5 years of applied data science experience Strong foundations in statistics, probability, optimization and machine learning, and the judgment to know when a simple model is enough. Fluent Python and SQL; comfort with modern data stacks (Spark, a cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Databricks, dbt or similar). Hands-on experience with at least one of: knowledge graphs, ontologies or semantic modelling, entity resolution, or LLM-based applications (retrieval, agents, evaluation). Strong verbal and written communication skills Strong plus Experience in real estate, proptech, finance, or any other asset-heavy domains. (preferred not mandatory) Published research, patents, competition results, or open-source work. Experience taking a model from notebook to production with MLOps practices. Project and Workstream Leadership · With support from Program/Project Leads and the Workday Time and Absence Architect, lead Time Tracking and Absence workstreams through planning, design, configuration, testing, deployment, cutover, and stabilization. · Develop and manage workstream plans covering scope, schedule, resources, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, and governance. · Coordinate internal teams, Workday consultants, implementation partners, and vendors, ensuring accountability for deliverables. · Identify and mitigate risks and issues, develop remediation plans, and escalate key decisions and dependencies as appropriate. · Lead workstream governance and communicate project status, risks, issues, and decisions to stakeholders using applicable project management standards and tools. · Manage multiple concurrent initiatives while maintaining alignment with program objectives and milestones. · Oversee partner and vendor deliverables, resources, timelines, budgets, and contractual commitments as applicable. Testing, Deployment and Quality Assurance · Lead Time Tracking and Absence testing, including test strategy, scenarios, defect management, and functional, integration, payroll, regression, and user acceptance testing. · Review solution designs, configurations, specifications, test plans, and other deliverables for quality and completeness. · Lead deployment readiness and cutover activities, including configuration migration, data validation, integration and business readiness, and go-live activities. · Provide functional and project leadership during stabilization and hypercare and ensure successful transition to operational support. Qualifications · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. · 5+ years of experience with Tier 1 HCM systems and HR technology implementations, including application configuration and complex technology projects. · Strong hands-on functional and configuration experience with Workday Time Tracking and Absence Management or equivalent Tier 1 HCM solutions. · Experience leading HR technology projects or workstreams in a global, matrixed organization. · Experience across the project lifecycle, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization. · Strong knowledge of Time Tracking and Absence processes and their dependencies with Payroll and other HCM processes. · Experience with M&A, divestitures, enterprise transformations, employee migrations, or similar cross-functional initiatives is strongly preferred. · Understanding of HR processes, HR data, and enterprise HCM systems, including impacts of organizational, policy, and system changes. · Knowledge of Workday HCM, Payroll, Compensation, security, business processes, and integrations is preferred.
